name: Canes Venatici C (Hubble)
blurb: Canes Venatici C, a dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: canesvenaticic-hubble
story: A quiet dwarf galaxy that has stopped forming stars and holds no detectable gas, living far from any large galaxy. A past encounter with the galaxy NGC 4631 may have shut down its star formation and sent it out on an extreme orbit.

claims.text: Canes Venatici C (CVn C) is a dwarf galaxy imaged with new Hubble data
CVn C is quenched with no recent star formation and no detectable gas
CVn C is in an isolated environment
CVn C may have quenched via past interactions with NGC 4631 and been sent on an extreme backsplash orbit
Canes Venatici C was a Hubble target of program 17481 (isolated ultra-faint dwarf candidates)
